name: yudirect
description: YuDirect — plataforma SaaS de gestão de frotas e locadoras (reconstrução fiel das referências visuais).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @yudirect/contracts && npm run build -w @yudirect/api && npm run build -w @yudirect/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @yudirect/api" "npm run dev -w @yudirect/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @yudirect/contracts && npm run test -w @yudirect/api && npm run test -w @yudirect/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @yudirect/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @yudirect/api && npm run typecheck -w @yudirect/web
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:demo -w @yudirect/api" "npm run dev -w @yudirect/web"
